name: Schedule I (Dedicated — Experimental)
author: ops@refx.example
description: EXPERIMENTAL: Schedule I dedicated server — the Windows game run headless under Proton/Wine with MelonLoader and the S1DedicatedServers (DedicatedServerMod) mod by ifBars, which replaces Steam P2P with direct-IP FishNet networking for 24/7 hosting. Players install the matching client mod on the Steam "alternate" branch and Direct Connect. Requires a host game-download Steam account that OWNS Schedule I (Admin -> Settings -> Steam). Mod project: https://github.com/ifBars/S1DedicatedServers
startupDetect: Status query endpoint listening|Host console transport started|=== Dedicated Server Starting ===

installScript.script:
#!/bin/bash
# ReFx steamcmd shim — the steamcmd:proton install image ships no `steamcmd` on
# PATH. Bootstrap SteamCMD into the server dir (STEAMCMD-variable variant so the
# HOME= override invocation works for the owning-account login).
if command -v steamcmd >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  STEAMCMD=steamcmd
else
  echo "[steam] bootstrapping steamcmd"
  mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
  curl -sSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar zxf - -C /mnt/server/steamcmd || { echo "ERROR: failed to fetch steamcmd"; exit 1; }
  chmod +x /mnt/server/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh /mnt/server/steamcmd/linux32/steamcmd 2>/dev/null || true
  STEAMCMD=/mnt/server/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh
fi
set -uo pipefail
# --- ReFx SteamCMD update safety (injected) --------------------------------
# Guards every Steam update: a stuck/partial SteamCMD run must NOT be reported
# as success. We key off the app manifest StateFlags ("4" == fully installed),
# but for a FORCED-WINDOWS download the manifest can lie, so the primary check
# below is ground-truth exe presence (palworld-windows pattern).
REFX_APPID="3164500"
refx_steam_manifest() { echo "/mnt/server/steamapps/appmanifest_${1}.acf"; }
refx_steam_installed() { local m; m="$(refx_steam_manifest "$1")"; [ -f "$m" ] && grep -Eq '"StateFlags"[[:space:]]+"4"' "$m"; }
refx_steam_heal() { # drop a stale/partial manifest so this update re-acquires cleanly
  local m; m="$(refx_steam_manifest "$1")"
  if [ -f "$m" ] && ! refx_steam_installed "$1"; then
    echo "[refx] steam app $1: stale manifest from a previous partial install — clearing so this update re-acquires cleanly."
    rm -f "$m" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  rm -rf "/mnt/server/steamapps/downloading/$1" "/mnt/server/steamapps/temp/$1" 2>/dev/null || true
}
refx_steam_verify() { # manifest sanity check (secondary to the exe ground truth)
  if refx_steam_installed "$1"; then
    echo "[refx] steam app $1 manifest reports fully installed."
    return 0
  fi
  echo "[refx] WARN: steam app $1 manifest does not report fully-installed (forced-Windows manifests can lag; the exe ground-truth check above is authoritative)."
  return 0
}
refx_make_writable() {
  # Installs run as ROOT; a reinstall leaves game-uid-owned files that trip
  # SteamCMD's "Missing file permissions" pre-check. Re-assert before every run.
  chown -R root:root /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true
  chmod -R u+rwX /mnt/server 2>/dev/null || true
}
refx_steam_clean() {
  # Clean forced-Windows acquire state. NEVER touches UserData/ (server saves)
  # or the customer's configs at the install root.
  rm -rf /mnt/server/steamapps 2>/dev/null || true
  rm -rf /home/container/Steam/appcache /root/Steam/appcache /mnt/server/Steam/appcache 2>/dev/null || true
  refx_make_writable
}
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
refx_steam_heal "$REFX_APPID"
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps
cd /mnt/server
refx_make_writable

# ---- Owning-account login (Schedule I is a PAID game: no anonymous path) ----
# The HOST game-download account (Admin -> Settings -> Steam) must own the game.
# Per-account node-level Steam home persists Guard machine-auth across servers.
SERVER_HOME=/mnt/server/.steamhome
mkdir -p "$SERVER_HOME"
if [ -n "${REFX_NODE_STEAM_HOME:-}" ]; then
  GAME_HOME="$REFX_NODE_STEAM_HOME/${STEAM_GAME_USERNAME:-anonymous}"
else
  GAME_HOME="$SERVER_HOME"
fi
mkdir -p "$GAME_HOME" 2>/dev/null || GAME_HOME="$SERVER_HOME"
HAVE_CREDS=0
if [ -n "${STEAM_GAME_USERNAME:-}" ] && [ -n "${STEAM_GAME_PASSWORD:-}" ]; then
  HAVE_CREDS=1
  GLOGIN=(+login "$STEAM_GAME_USERNAME" "$STEAM_GAME_PASSWORD")
  [ -n "${STEAM_GAME_GUARD:-}" ] && GLOGIN+=("$STEAM_GAME_GUARD")
else
  GLOGIN=(+login anonymous)
fi
# Only a real DOWNLOAD needs the owning account — an already-installed server
# must still be able to Update/reinstall (mod + config steps) without it.
require_creds() {
  [ "$HAVE_CREDS" = "1" ] && return 0
  echo "[refx] ERROR: Schedule I is a paid game with no anonymous dedicated-server app."
  echo "[refx] Configure a game-download Steam account that OWNS Schedule I in"
  echo "[refx] Admin -> Settings -> Steam, then reinstall. Refusing to attempt an"
  echo "[refx] anonymous download that cannot succeed."
  exit 1
}

# ---- Branch / runtime selector ---------------------------------------------
# Schedule I ships two runtimes and the mod ships a matching server+client pair
# for each. The Steam branch and the mod asset MUST agree, and every connecting
# player must be on the SAME branch with the matching client zip:
#   GAME_BRANCH=alternate -> Mono   runtime -> Mono-Server.zip  / Mono-Client.zip
#   GAME_BRANCH=default   -> IL2CPP runtime -> Il2cpp_Server.zip / Il2cpp_Client.zip
case "$(printf '%s' "${GAME_BRANCH:-alternate}" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')" in
  default|public|none|il2cpp)
    S1_BRANCH="default"; S1_RUNTIME="IL2CPP"
    S1DS_ASSET="Il2cpp_Server.zip"; S1DS_CLIENT="Il2cpp_Client.zip"
    BETA_ARGS=()
    ;;
  *)
    S1_BRANCH="alternate"; S1_RUNTIME="Mono"
    S1DS_ASSET="Mono-Server.zip"; S1DS_CLIENT="Mono-Client.zip"
    BETA_ARGS=(-beta alternate)
    ;;
esac
echo "[refx] Branch: ${S1_BRANCH} (${S1_RUNTIME} runtime) — players need the Steam '${S1_BRANCH}' branch + ${S1DS_CLIENT}."

# ---- Download the Windows game build ---------------------------------------
# Ground-truth verify on the exe; forced-Windows manifests can lie. A branch
# change re-runs SteamCMD even when an exe is already present, so switching
# runtimes actually swaps the build instead of silently keeping the old one.
S1_EXE="/mnt/server/Schedule I.exe"
BRANCH_STAMP=/mnt/server/.refx-branch
STEAM_LOG="$(mktemp 2>/dev/null || echo /tmp/refx-steam.log)"
steam_win_update() {
  HOME="$GAME_HOME" "$STEAMCMD" +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server "${GLOGIN[@]}" +app_update 3164500 "${BETA_ARGS[@]}" validate +quit </dev/null 2>&1 | tee "$STEAM_LOG"
}
INSTALLED_BRANCH="$(cat "$BRANCH_STAMP" 2>/dev/null || echo '')"
NEED_DL=0
[ -f "$S1_EXE" ] || NEED_DL=1
[ "$INSTALLED_BRANCH" = "$S1_BRANCH" ] || NEED_DL=1
if [ "$NEED_DL" = "0" ]; then
  echo "[refx] Schedule I (${S1_BRANCH}) already present — skipping the SteamCMD download (delete 'Schedule I.exe' to force a re-fetch)."
  [ "$HAVE_CREDS" = "1" ] || echo "[refx] NOTE: no game-download Steam account configured. The installed build keeps working, but future game-build updates need one (Admin -> Settings -> Steam)."
else
  require_creds
  if [ -n "$INSTALLED_BRANCH" ] && [ "$INSTALLED_BRANCH" != "$S1_BRANCH" ]; then
    echo "[refx] Branch change: ${INSTALLED_BRANCH} -> ${S1_BRANCH}. Re-acquiring the game build; your save under UserData/ is untouched."
  fi
  echo "[refx] Fetching Schedule I (app 3164500, ${S1_BRANCH}/${S1_RUNTIME}) with the host game-download account..."
  steam_win_update || true
fi
if [ ! -f "$S1_EXE" ]; then
  require_creds
  echo "[refx] Build not present after the first SteamCMD run — clearing Steam depot state and retrying one clean acquire. Server saves under UserData/ are untouched."
  refx_steam_clean
  steam_win_update || true
fi
if [ ! -f "$S1_EXE" ]; then
  echo "[refx] ERROR: 'Schedule I.exe' is still missing after a clean retry."
  echo "[refx] Common causes: the account does not OWN Schedule I; a Steam Guard code is"
  echo "[refx] needed (set a fresh EMAIL code in Admin -> Settings -> Steam and reinstall;"
  echo "[refx] the node is remembered after the first success); or a transient Steam error."
  echo "[refx] Last SteamCMD output:"
  tail -n 25 "$STEAM_LOG" 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/[refx][steam] /' || true
  echo "[refx][diag] install uid:gid = $(id -u 2>/dev/null):$(id -g 2>/dev/null)"
  df -h /mnt/server 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/[refx][disk] /' || true
  ls -ln /mnt/server 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/[refx][diag] /' | head -20 || true
  exit 1
fi
refx_steam_verify "$REFX_APPID"
printf '%s' "$S1_BRANCH" > "$BRANCH_STAMP" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "[refx] Schedule I build present (ground-truth: Schedule I.exe, branch ${S1_BRANCH}/${S1_RUNTIME})."

# ---- Extract helper (images may ship no unzip) ------------------------------
refx_unzip() { # $1=zip  $2=destdir
  if command -v unzip >/dev/null 2>&1; then unzip -o "$1" -d "$2" >/dev/null; return $?; fi
  if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then python3 -m zipfile -e "$1" "$2"; return $?; fi
  if command -v bsdtar >/dev/null 2>&1; then bsdtar -xf "$1" -C "$2"; return $?; fi
  apt-get update >/dev/null 2>&1 && apt-get install -y unzip >/dev/null 2>&1 && unzip -o "$1" -d "$2" >/dev/null
}

# ---- MelonLoader (pinned; 0.7.1 is known-broken, never use it) --------------
ML_TAG="v0.7.2"
ML_URL="https://github.com/LavaGang/MelonLoader/releases/download/${ML_TAG}/MelonLoader.x64.zip"
# Record the installed tags so an egg-side version bump actually propagates on
# the next Update (skip-if-present alone would pin every server forever).
ML_STAMP=/mnt/server/.refx-melonloader-tag
S1DS_STAMP=/mnt/server/.refx-s1ds-tag
if [ -f /mnt/server/version.dll ] && [ -d /mnt/server/MelonLoader ] && [ "$(cat "$ML_STAMP" 2>/dev/null)" = "$ML_TAG" ]; then
  echo "[refx] MelonLoader ${ML_TAG} already installed — keeping it."
else
  echo "[refx] MelonLoader: downloading ${ML_TAG} (${ML_URL})"
  curl -fSL -o /tmp/refx-ml.zip "$ML_URL" || { echo "[refx] ERROR: failed to download MelonLoader ${ML_TAG}."; exit 1; }
  refx_unzip /tmp/refx-ml.zip /mnt/server || { echo "[refx] ERROR: failed to extract MelonLoader."; exit 1; }
  rm -f /tmp/refx-ml.zip 2>/dev/null || true
  printf '%s' "$ML_TAG" > "$ML_STAMP" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/version.dll ]; then
  echo "[refx] ERROR: MelonLoader's version.dll proxy is missing after extraction — the loader cannot inject."
  ls -la /mnt/server 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/[refx][diag] /' | head -30
  exit 1
fi

# ---- S1DedicatedServers server mod (pinned release) -------------------------
# DedicatedServerMod by ifBars — GPL-3.0. https://github.com/ifBars/S1DedicatedServers
S1DS_TAG="v1.0.1-beta.2"
S1DS_URL="https://github.com/ifBars/S1DedicatedServers/releases/download/${S1DS_TAG}/${S1DS_ASSET}"
# Stamp includes the RUNTIME so switching branch re-fetches the matching build.
S1DS_WANT="${S1DS_TAG}-${S1_RUNTIME}"
mkdir -p /mnt/server/Mods
have_server_dll() { find /mnt/server/Mods -maxdepth 2 -iname 'DedicatedServerMod*Server*.dll' -print -quit 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; }
if have_server_dll && [ "$(cat "$S1DS_STAMP" 2>/dev/null)" = "$S1DS_WANT" ]; then
  echo "[refx] S1DedicatedServers ${S1DS_TAG} (${S1_RUNTIME}) already installed — keeping it."
else
  # Version bump (or first install): drop the previous server DLL so the new
  # release can't load alongside a stale one.
  find /mnt/server/Mods -maxdepth 2 -iname 'DedicatedServerMod*Server*.dll' -delete 2>/dev/null || true
  echo "[refx] S1DedicatedServers: downloading ${S1DS_TAG} (${S1DS_URL})"
  curl -fSL -o /tmp/refx-s1ds.zip "$S1DS_URL" || { echo "[refx] ERROR: failed to download S1DedicatedServers ${S1DS_TAG}."; exit 1; }
  refx_unzip /tmp/refx-s1ds.zip /mnt/server || { echo "[refx] ERROR: failed to extract S1DedicatedServers."; exit 1; }
  rm -f /tmp/refx-s1ds.zip 2>/dev/null || true
  # Some releases nest the payload one directory deep — flatten a lone
  # Mods/-containing top-level dir into the server root (best-effort).
  if ! have_server_dll; then
    for d in /mnt/server/Mono-Server /mnt/server/Il2cpp_Server /mnt/server/Server /mnt/server/S1DedicatedServers*; do
      if [ -d "$d/Mods" ]; then
        cp -a "$d"/. /mnt/server/ 2>/dev/null || true
        rm -rf "$d" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    done
  fi
  have_server_dll && { printf '%s' "$S1DS_WANT" > "$S1DS_STAMP" 2>/dev/null || true; }
fi
if ! have_server_dll; then
  echo "[refx] ERROR: the S1DedicatedServers server DLL is not present under Mods/ after extraction."
  find /mnt/server -maxdepth 3 -iname '*DedicatedServer*' 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/[refx][diag] /' | head -20
  ls -la /mnt/server/Mods 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/[refx][diag] /' | head -20
  exit 1
fi
echo "[refx] ------------------------------------------------------------------"
echo "[refx] Server mod: S1DedicatedServers / DedicatedServerMod by ifBars"
echo "[refx] Version: ${S1DS_TAG} (MelonLoader ${ML_TAG}, ${S1_RUNTIME} / Steam '${S1_BRANCH}' branch)"
echo "[refx] Project: https://github.com/ifBars/S1DedicatedServers"
echo "[refx] Docs:    https://docs.s1servers.com"
echo "[refx] Players must install the matching CLIENT mod (${S1DS_CLIENT}) and the"
echo "[refx] Steam '' branch, then Direct Connect to this server's address."
echo "[refx] ------------------------------------------------------------------"

# ---- Steam identity + native steamclient bridge -----------------------------
# Schedule I IS the game app, so download appid == identity appid (3164500).
printf '3164500' > /mnt/server/steam_appid.txt 2>/dev/null || true
# Proton's lsteamclient dlopens $HOME/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so (hardcoded,
# Proton#9068). /mnt/server == /home/container at runtime, so stage there — and
# copy the WHOLE source dir so sibling libs stay a matched set.
sc_find() { # $1 = 32|64
  find "$GAME_HOME" /mnt/server/steamcmd /home/container/Steam /home/container/.steam /root/.steam /root/.local /usr \
    2>/dev/null -type f -name steamclient.so \
    \( -path "*linux$1*" -o -path "*ubuntu12_$1*" -o -path "*sdk$1*" \) 2>/dev/null | head -n1
}
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32 /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64 /mnt/server/.steam/steam
SC64="$(sc_find 64)"; SC32="$(sc_find 32)"
if [ -n "$SC64" ] && [ -f "$SC64" ]; then
  cp -af "$(dirname "$SC64")/." /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/ 2>/dev/null || cp -f "$SC64" /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so
  echo "[refx] steamclient.so (64-bit) + siblings staged into ~/.steam/sdk64 from $(dirname "$SC64")"
else
  echo "[refx] WARN: 64-bit steamclient.so not found — Steam game-server auth may fail at runtime."
fi
if [ -n "$SC32" ] && [ -f "$SC32" ]; then
  cp -af "$(dirname "$SC32")/." /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/ 2>/dev/null || cp -f "$SC32" /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so
fi
# Windows Steamworks redistributables (app 1007, anonymous): the WINE fallback
# path has no Proton steam bridge, so the game needs steam_api64.dll et al next
# to the exe. Best-effort — the Proton path works without it.
if [ ! -f "/mnt/server/steam_api64.dll" ]; then
  SDK_DIR=/mnt/server/.refx-steamsdk
  if HOME="$GAME_HOME" "$STEAMCMD" +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir "$SDK_DIR" +login anonymous +app_update 1007 +quit </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    for dll in steam_api64.dll steamclient64.dll tier0_s64.dll vstdlib_s64.dll; do
      f="$(find "$SDK_DIR" -type f -iname "$dll" 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
      [ -n "$f" ] && cp -f "$f" /mnt/server/ 2>/dev/null || true
    done
    echo "[refx] Steamworks redistributables staged next to the exe (wine-path fallback)."
  else
    echo "[refx] NOTE: could not fetch the Steamworks redistributables (app 1007) — harmless on the Proton path."
  fi
fi

# ---- Port config note -------------------------------------------------------
# serverPort (gameplay UDP + the mod's TCP status endpoint) can only come from
# server_config.toml, and that file does not exist until the first boot creates
# it — so the LAUNCHER owns port alignment (it seeds the file when missing and
# re-asserts the port every boot, since the server rewrites the config).
echo "[refx] port alignment is handled by refx-run.sh on every boot (serverPort -> the panel allocation)."

# ---- Probe: which Windows runner does this image expose? --------------------
echo "[refx][probe] locating a Proton/wine runner in the image..."
for c in proton wine wine64 python3; do command -v "$c" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "[refx][probe] on PATH: $(command -v "$c")"; done
find /home/container /usr /opt /root -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -name proton -o -name wine -o -name wine64 \) 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/[refx][probe] found runner: /' | head -10

# ---- Write the ReFx launcher (startupCommand = "bash refx-run.sh") ----------
cat > /mnt/server/refx-run.sh <<'RUNEOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -u
cd /home/container 2>/dev/null || cd "$(dirname "$0")"
# MelonLoader injects through a version.dll PROXY next to the game exe. Wine
# ships its own builtin version.dll, so force the NATIVE (proxy) DLL first or
# the mod loader never loads. (UE4SS eggs use dwmapi here; MelonLoader is version.)
export WINEDLLOVERRIDES="version=n,b"
export WINEDEBUG="${WINEDEBUG:-fixme-all}"
EXE="./Schedule I.exe"
CONSOLE=./refx-console.log
MLLOG=./MelonLoader/Latest.log
PORT="${SERVER_PORT:-38465}"
MAXP="$(printf '%s' "${MAX_PLAYERS:-8}" | tr -cd '0-9')"; MAXP="${MAXP:-8}"
QP="$(printf '%s' "${QUERY_PORT:-}" | tr -cd '0-9')"
# NOTE: --server-port is a CLIENT-side flag (auto-connect), NOT the server's
# listen port — per the mod's docs the listen port comes ONLY from serverPort in
# server_config.toml. --max-players IS honoured server-side ("Max players set
# to: N" in the log), so it stays here.
MOD_ARGS=(--max-players "$MAXP")

# ---- Bind the server to the PANEL's allocated port -------------------------
# serverPort drives BOTH the gameplay UDP socket AND the mod's TCP status-query
# endpoint (same number). The mod defaults to 38465, which Docker never
# publishes, so without this nobody can connect. The config file only exists
# after a first boot, so do this in the LAUNCHER: create it when missing, fix it
# every boot (the server rewrites the file, so an install-time edit won't hold).
s1_set_key() { # $1=file $2=section $3=key $4=value
  local f="$1" sec="$2" key="$3" val="$4"
  if grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*${key}[[:space:]]*=" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
    sed -i -E "s/^([[:space:]]*${key}[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*).*/\1${val}/" "$f"
  elif grep -Eq "^\[${sec}\]" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
    sed -i -E "/^\[${sec}\]/a ${key} = ${val}" "$f"
  else
    printf '\n[%s]\n%s = %s\n' "$sec" "$key" "$val" >> "$f"
  fi
}
s1_align_cfg() { # $1 = config path
  local f="$1"
  mkdir -p "$(dirname "$f")" 2>/dev/null || true
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    s1_set_key "$f" server serverPort "$PORT"
    [ -n "$QP" ] && s1_set_key "$f" authentication steamGameServerQueryPort "$QP"
  else
    {
      printf '[server]\nserverPort = %s\nmaxPlayers = %s\n' "$PORT" "$MAXP"
      [ -n "$QP" ] && printf '\n[authentication]\nsteamGameServerQueryPort = %s\n' "$QP"
    } > "$f"
  fi
  if grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]*serverPort[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*${PORT}([[:space:]]|$)" "$f" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "[refx] config OK: $f -> serverPort = ${PORT}"
  else
    echo "[refx] WARN: failed to set serverPort in $f"
  fi
}
# CONFIRMED from the mod's source (ServerConfig.Runtime.cs GetDefaultConfigFilePath
# -> Path.Combine(MelonEnvironment.UserDataDirectory, "server_config.toml")): the
# ONLY config the server reads is UserData/server_config.toml. The install root is
# never consulted, and there is no CLI flag or env var for serverPort.
s1_align_cfg ./UserData/server_config.toml
# A root-level copy (written by older versions of this egg, or by hand after the
# mod's own misleading "server_config.json" tip) is silently ignored by the
# server and only causes confusion — move it aside rather than delete it.
if [ -f ./server_config.toml ]; then
  mv -f ./server_config.toml ./server_config.toml.ignored-by-server 2>/dev/null \
    && echo "[refx] moved the ignored root server_config.toml aside (the server only reads UserData/server_config.toml)."
fi
# Unity headless flags. Without -nographics the engine initializes a graphics
# device (DXGI -> D3D11 -> Vulkan) and page-faults inside dxgi on a container
# with no GPU: "Unhandled page fault ... in dxgi" right after MelonLoader loads.
# Overridable from the Startup tab in case a future build needs different flags.
LAUNCH_ARGS="${LAUNCH_ARGS:--batchmode -nographics}"

echo "[refx] launcher starting (pwd=$PWD)."
echo "[refx] S1DedicatedServers / DedicatedServerMod by ifBars — https://github.com/ifBars/S1DedicatedServers"
command -v xvfb-run >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "[refx] WARNING: xvfb-run is not on PATH."
[ -f "$EXE" ] && echo "[refx] game exe present." || echo "[refx] ERROR: $EXE is missing — reinstall."
[ -f ./version.dll ] && echo "[refx] MelonLoader version.dll proxy present." || echo "[refx] WARNING: version.dll missing (MelonLoader will not load)."
[ -f ./UserData/server_config.toml ] && echo "[refx] UserData/server_config.toml present (the only config the server reads)." || echo "[refx] NOTE: UserData/server_config.toml will be seeded below so the first boot binds port $PORT."

# No wine/proton on PATH under the agent (the image entrypoint that sets them up
# is bypassed) — locate a runner: Proton preferred, wine fallback.
PROTON=""; WINEBIN=""
for p in "$(command -v proton 2>/dev/null)" \
         /home/container/GE-Proton*/proton \
         /home/container/.steam/steam/compatibilitytools.d/*/proton \
         /home/container/.steam/steam/steamapps/common/Proton*/proton \
         /usr/local/bin/proton /opt/proton*/proton; do
  [ -n "${p:-}" ] && [ -f "$p" ] && { PROTON="$p"; break; }
done
for w in "$(command -v wine64 2>/dev/null)" "$(command -v wine 2>/dev/null)" \
         /home/container/GE-Proton*/files/bin/wine64 \
         /home/container/GE-Proton*/files/bin/wine \
         /usr/local/bin/files/bin/wine64 /usr/local/bin/files/bin/wine \
         /usr/lib/wine/wine64 /opt/wine*/bin/wine64 \
         /usr/local/bin/wine64 /usr/local/bin/wine; do
  [ -n "${w:-}" ] && [ -f "$w" ] && { WINEBIN="$w"; break; }
done
if [ -z "$PROTON" ] && [ -z "$WINEBIN" ]; then
  found="$(find /home/container /usr /opt /root -maxdepth 6 -type f \( -name proton -o -name wine64 -o -name wine \) 2>/dev/null | head -n1)"
  case "${found:-}" in
    */proton) PROTON="$found";;
    */wine*)  WINEBIN="$found";;
  esac
fi
if [ -z "$PROTON" ] && [ -z "$WINEBIN" ]; then
  echo "[refx] FATAL: no Proton or wine runner found in this image."
  ls -la /usr/local/bin 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/[refx][diag] /' | head -30
  exit 1
fi

SRV=
STDIN_PUMP=
STDIN_FIFO=./.refx-stdin
shutdown() {
  [ -n "$SRV" ] && kill -TERM "$SRV" 2>/dev/null
  [ -n "$STDIN_PUMP" ] && kill -TERM "$STDIN_PUMP" 2>/dev/null
  command -v wineserver >/dev/null 2>&1 && wineserver -k 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap shutdown TERM INT

: > "$CONSOLE"
# Recreate the console FIFO each boot (a stale one from a hard kill would block).
rm -f "$STDIN_FIFO" 2>/dev/null || true
mkfifo "$STDIN_FIFO" 2>/dev/null || { echo "[refx] WARN: could not create the console FIFO — panel console commands will not reach the game."; STDIN_FIFO=/dev/null; }
if [ -n "$PROTON" ]; then
  echo "[refx] using Proton runner: $PROTON"
  export HOME="${HOME:-/home/container}"
  export STEAM_COMPAT_CLIENT_INSTALL_PATH="${STEAM_COMPAT_CLIENT_INSTALL_PATH:-/home/container/.steam/steam}"
  export STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH="${STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH:-/home/container/.steam/steam/steamapps/compatdata/3164500}"
  export STEAM_COMPAT_APP_ID=3164500 SteamAppId=3164500 SteamGameId=3164500
  mkdir -p "$STEAM_COMPAT_DATA_PATH" "$STEAM_COMPAT_CLIENT_INSTALL_PATH"
  if [ -f "$HOME/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so" ]; then
    echo "[refx] steamclient.so present at $HOME/.steam/sdk64 — Steam bridge should init."
  else
    echo "[refx] WARNING: $HOME/.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so is MISSING — reinstall to stage it."
  fi
  echo "[refx] launching via Proton: $EXE $LAUNCH_ARGS ${MOD_ARGS[*]} --stdio-console"
  # Feed the launcher's own stdin (the panel console) into the game through a
  # FIFO: backgrounding a process gives it /dev/null stdin, so the mod's
  # --stdio-console would see immediate EOF and no panel command could land.
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # LAUNCH_ARGS is a deliberate multi-flag string
  xvfb-run -a "$PROTON" run "$EXE" $LAUNCH_ARGS "${MOD_ARGS[@]}" --stdio-console < "$STDIN_FIFO" > "$CONSOLE" 2>&1 &
  SRV=$!
else
  echo "[refx] using wine runner: $WINEBIN"
  export WINEARCH=win64
  export WINEPREFIX="${WINEPREFIX:-/home/container/.wine}"
  export PATH="$(dirname "$WINEBIN"):$PATH"
  export SteamAppId=3164500 SteamGameId=3164500
  if [ ! -f "$WINEPREFIX/system.reg" ]; then
    echo "[refx] initializing wine prefix at $WINEPREFIX (first boot; can take a minute)..."
    xvfb-run -a "$WINEBIN" wineboot --init >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    command -v wineserver >/dev/null 2>&1 && wineserver -w 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
  echo "[refx] launching via wine: $EXE $LAUNCH_ARGS ${MOD_ARGS[*]} --stdio-console"
  # shellcheck disable=SC2086 # LAUNCH_ARGS is a deliberate multi-flag string
  xvfb-run -a "$WINEBIN" "$EXE" $LAUNCH_ARGS "${MOD_ARGS[@]}" --stdio-console < "$STDIN_FIFO" > "$CONSOLE" 2>&1 &
  SRV=$!
fi
# Pump panel console input into the FIFO (holds it open so the game never sees
# EOF). Runs in the background; dies with the launcher.
( cat > "$STDIN_FIFO" ) &
STDIN_PUMP=$!
# Stream the runner console + MelonLoader log so mod init and errors are visible.
tail -n +1 -F "$CONSOLE" "$MLLOG" 2>/dev/null &

while kill -0 "$SRV" 2>/dev/null; do wait "$SRV" 2>/dev/null; done
RC=$?
echo "[refx] Schedule I server exited (code $RC)."
echo "[refx] --- last 80 lines of the runner console ---"
tail -n 80 "$CONSOLE" 2>/dev/null
echo "[refx] --- last 40 lines of MelonLoader/Latest.log ---"
tail -n 40 "$MLLOG" 2>/dev/null
if grep -q 'in dxgi\|d3d11\|Failed to initialize graphics' "$CONSOLE" 2>/dev/null; then
  echo "[refx] DIAGNOSIS: the crash is Unity graphics init (dxgi/D3D) — this container has no GPU."
  echo "[refx] The launcher passes '$LAUNCH_ARGS'; if you cleared or changed LAUNCH_ARGS on the"
  echo "[refx] Startup tab, restore '-batchmode -nographics'."
fi
echo "[refx] (experimental egg: game updates can outpace the mod — if boot broke after a Schedule I patch, wait for the next S1DedicatedServers release, then reinstall.)"
RUNEOF
chmod +x /mnt/server/refx-run.sh
echo "[refx] wrote refx-run.sh launcher (startup runs: bash refx-run.sh)."
echo "Schedule I (S1DedicatedServers ${S1DS_TAG}) install complete."

variables.description: Maximum concurrent players ([server].maxPlayers in server_config.toml — the mod removes the vanilla 4-player Steam-lobby cap). For now edit server_config.toml via the file manager after first boot; this field sizes plan tiers.

Which Schedule I build to run. 'alternate' = the Mono branch (server uses Mono-Server, players need Steam's 'alternate' beta branch + Mono-Client). 'default' = the public branch (IL2CPP; Il2cpp_Server / Il2cpp_Client). The server, every client, and the mod build must all match. Changing this re-downloads the game on the next Update; your save under UserData/ is preserved.

Flags passed to the game before --stdio-console. '-batchmode -nographics' keeps Unity from initializing a graphics device — required on a GPU-less node, or the server crashes in dxgi right after MelonLoader loads. Only change this if a future build needs different flags.
UDP port for Steam game-server queries (allocated by the panel; wired into server_config.toml where the key exists).

longDescription: EXPERIMENTAL 24/7 Schedule I dedicated server, powered by S1DedicatedServers (DedicatedServerMod) by ifBars (GPL-3.0) with MelonLoader — https://github.com/ifBars/S1DedicatedServers / https://docs.s1servers.com. Direct-IP joins: every player installs the matching client mod and the Steam "alternate" beta branch. Version-pinned stack; after Schedule I game updates, hold restarts until a compatible mod release ships.
